recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-28221; any future wording review of Goal.source should consider FHIR-41409 and FHIR-48366 as later decisions rather than treating the current wording as an incomplete application of the R5 issue.
issue_request: FHIR-28221 was a Published FHIR-core Goal change request resolved Persuasive with Modification for R5. It requested renaming Goal.expressedBy to Goal.source, adding CareTeam as an allowed reference target so a care team can establish goals in collaborative care, and updating the comment to say the individual or team establishes the goal rather than necessarily recording it.
initial_application: The issue was applied by commit a0156c2d5b9df2e612e21f4e69856cdb486f5ca7, which renamed the Goal example element from expressedBy to source, changed the StructureDefinition element to Goal.source, added CareTeam to the target profiles, and updated the comment to mention individual or team responsibility.
additional_context: Goal is active in source/fhir.ini and source/goal/structuredefinition-Goal.xml is therefore in build scope. Later applied R6 issues modified the same area: FHIR-41409 added Group to Goal.source and a Group-use comment, while FHIR-48366 added Goal.recorder and intentionally removed the old Provenance parenthetical from Goal.source because recorder now represents who recorded the goal. Patient Care Confluence records mention the original Goal/CareTeam discussion, and direct Zulip searching found no conflicting FHIR-28221 discussion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit is needed because current Goal.source includes CareTeam, has the source name, and still distinguishes who establishes the goal from who records it; re-adding the removed Provenance sentence would conflict with the later FHIR-48366 applied decision.

related_jiras.note: Added Group to Goal.source and the Group-use comment after FHIR-28221; it does not remove CareTeam support.
Added Goal.recorder and explicitly removed the old Provenance parenthetical from Goal.source, explaining the current comment wording.
